# `strrev` Function

`strrev` reverses the characters in a string.
Note that the characters are treated as _Unicode characters_ (in technical terms, Unicode [grapheme cluster boundaries](https://unicode.org/reports/tr29/#Grapheme_Cluster_Boundaries) are respected).

```dumb-hcl
strrev(string)
```

## Examples

```shell-session
> strrev("hello")
olleh
> strrev("a ☃")
☃ a
```

## Related Functions

- [`reverse`](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/functions/collection/reverse) reverses a sequence.
